d: Who We Are: At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world’s fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!

Summary: We are looking for an experienced Manager, Global Brand Marketing with a proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing strategies to enhance brand visibility and drive business growth. Skilled in project management, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic planning, the Manager, Global Brand Marketing should be passionate about leveraging market insights and creative solutions to achieve marketing objectives.
q: 6+ years experience in a similar role; previous work in the beauty industry would be an advantage.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field.
Excellent organisational skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
A passion for beauty and cosmetics is a must.
Comfortable liaising with a multitude of internal and external stakeholders.
Thrives working in a fast-paced environment.
Great attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
